sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Re: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
move.body:
Dear your company team,

You link wage pressure directly to your skilled team and emphasise our long relationship; it sounds like protecting continuity matters as much as recovering costs. We value that partnership and want a sustainable adjustment grounded in your stated wage-cost share and our should-cost assessment. How can a longer commitment give you the planning confidence to agree an adjustment that reflects those cost drivers?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,000 units per year for 24 months. Our should-cost estimate for this part is on record (cost:part:PH-100).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 48.92 per unit, 60 days payment, 24 months, from 2026-12-01). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €51.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
A few words from the foundry on this.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We value our long-standing partnership and welcome your commitment to a 24-month contract for 4,000 units per year.
While we have noted your should-cost estimate, it does not fully reflect the realities of our production costs, and we cannot accommodate a 60-day payment term.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €50.90 per unit.
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Re: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
move.body:
Dear your company team,

You acknowledge the shared cost evidence but return to payment timing; it sounds like payment predictability matters as much as a lasting commitment. We respect the privacy of your calculation and want an agreement that supports a fair, stable partnership. How can we address your payment concern while building on the cost evidence we both recognise?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,000 units per year for 24 months.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 49.23 per unit, 60 days payment, 24 months, from 2026-12-01). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your commitment to a 24-month volume and your focus on a stable partnership.

Our current offer stands at a price of €50.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

To address the payment concern directly, we can offer a more favorable price if we return to our standard 30-day payment terms. As an alternative package, we therefore propose a price of €50.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026, which reflects a fair balance for both our houses.

Regarding your query: Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Re: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
move.body:
Dear your company team,

Your willingness to trade price for earlier payment suggests that payment timing has real value to you alongside a stable partnership. We recognise your request for the figures behind our position and respect that your costing remains confidential. How can we balance payment timing and contract continuity to reach a sustainable agreement for both sides?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,000 units per year for 24 months. What is the lowest price at which you can sign these terms today?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 49.20 per unit, 30 days payment, 24 months, from 2026-12-01). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We appreciate your constructive approach and the continued trust between our two houses over all these years. In response to your movement, we are prepared to lower our price to €49.80 per unit, maintaining the 1 December 2026 effective date and 30-day payment terms. 

Please note that our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. For our complete Angebot, we offer a price of €49.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

We take great pride in our foundry and the dedicated craftsmanship of our people, and we look forward to continuing our traditional partnership with your respected house.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
